examples.title: Toggling Visibility
Hidden at Zero (unless `showZero`)
examples.code:
<Block display="flex">
  <Badge content={0} mr="5">
    <Icon name="bell" ariaLabel="Notifications" size="large" />
  </Badge>
  <Badge content={0} showZero>
    <Icon name="bell" ariaLabel="Notifications" size="large" />
  </Badge>
</Block>

examples.title: Standalone, Interactive

accessibility:
- A count/text badge exposes `role="status"` and an `aria-label` announcing its content.
- At `content={0}` without `showZero`, the pill is visually hidden but stays mounted as an
  empty `role="status"` node, so a later `0 -> 1` change mutates an existing live region and
  is reliably announced (a live region inserted already populated often isn't).
- A bare number in a `role="status"` span is not enough context on its own — put the full
  meaning on the anchor itself, e.g. `<Icon ariaLabel="Inbox, 4 unread messages" />` rather than
  relying on the badge to read out just "4".
- A decorative `dot` badge is `aria-hidden`.
- `pulse` respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and renders without animation.
- Note the two hide mechanisms differ: the Bulma `visibility="invisible"` helper hides the whole
  wrapper (anchor included), while the `invisible` **prop** hides only the badge pill.
summary: The `Badge` component is a small status/count indicator overlaid on the corner of another element, or rendered standalone.

parts.summary: The `Badge` component is a small status/count indicator overlaid on the corner of another element, or rendered standalone.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the root — the wrapper when `children` are present, else the badge pill.

props.name: badgeClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the badge pill itself (unprefixed, like `Tooltip`'s `tooltipClassName`).

props.name: content
props.description: Count, short text, or a custom node to display; omit with `dot` for a plain dot. `max`/`showZero` apply only to numeric content.

props.name: max
props.description: Numeric `content` above this renders as `"{max}+"`. A negative or non-integer value falls back to the default.

props.name: dot
props.description: Render a small dot with no content.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Show the badge when `content` is `0`. Default `false`.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner to overlay the badge on, relative to `children`. Ignored for standalone badges (no `children`).

props.name: overlap
props.description: Nudges the offset for a round (`'circle'`) vs rectangular (`'square'`) child. Ignored for standalone badges (no `children`).

props.name: invisible
props.description: Hide the badge pill without unmounting it (the wrapper and `children` stay visible).

props.name: children
props.description: The element the badge overlays. Omit to render a standalone badge.
